title: Blue Composition
provenance: Acquired by the estate of A. Kadir Ahmad in 1875, held at the Gallery of Tengku Imran until 1902, sold to the private collection of the late Sultan Muhammad Ali of Johor in 1918, and later donated to the exhibition 'Art Nouveau in Southeast Asia' in 1937 by the patronage of Lady Amelia Tan Sri Wan.
previous_owner: Collection of the late Dato' R. Sivanathan
